description: Write to_force_graph output as graph-force.json in the static folder. The page can load {nodes, links} without transforming in the browser.
scope: Assert keys are nodes and links
acceptanceCriteria: publish_force_graph(sample graph dict, tmp_static) creates tmp_static/graph-force.json whose parsed body has nodes and links.
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add UI, watcher, or CLI code unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not change to_force_graph field names.

subtasks.title: Write static/graph-force.json
subtasks.summary: Reuse to_force_graph. One file. No canvas.

relatedArtifacts.purpose: Tiny graph dict for the write test.

scope: Assert keys are nodes and links
dataExamples: Top-level keys are nodes and links.
businessRules: Create static_dir if it does not exist.
Overwrite graph-force.json when it already exists.
Call to_force_graph. Do not rebuild color or size here.
instructions: Write the failing test in tests/test_publish_force_graph.py first.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_publish_force_graph.py -q and confirm failure.
Run python -m pytest tests/test_publish_force_graph.py -q and stop when it passes.
